import now, close_output from "./helper.ms"
import stdout from "@std/io/io.ms"
import monotonic from "@std/time.ms"

export fn main() Int:
    before := now()
    if monotonic() - before < 0.milliseconds(): return 1

    close_output()

    cause := match stdout().write(""):
        ok(_):
            return 3
        error(cause): cause

    match cause:
        Closed:
            return 0
        _:
            return 4
